entities.name: 5GS network feature support
entities.description: Information element used by the network to inform the UE about support of certain 5GS features. When not included, UE interprets it as all bits coded as zero.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the 5GS network feature support IE in messages.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives and interprets the 5GS network feature support IE.

entities.name: IE absent condition
entities.description: Condition when the 5GS network feature support IE is not included in the message.

entities.name: All bits zero interpretation
entities.description: UE behavior when IE is absent - interprets it as all bits of the value part coded as zero.

relations.description: Network may include the 5GS network feature support IE in messages to inform UE about feature support.
When IE is not included, UE shall interpret it as all bits of the value part coded as zero.
UE receives and interprets the 5GS network feature support IE from the network.
